title: Vet clinic
description: Kenney-style vet clinic, 9 x 8 m: cream walls with teal trim and big teal-framed windows, a low slate gable roof with a white paw-print sign over the front, a slate front door. Built-in interior for the cutaway: mint checker waiting room, pale exam room with exam table, sink and pegboard, wood-floored studio, two low animal benches in the waiting room. roof / walls (6 face groups, origins on the ground) / interior.
